theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라

theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

top_news.summary: Severe weather disruptions will amplify food security risks in Asia, potentially triggering civil unrest and political instability in vulnerable countries such as India, Indonesia and the Philippines, according to consultancy Verisk Maplecroft.

top_news.title: Chelsea Strikes Deal for Exit of Walter, Boehly as Shareholders
top_news.summary: Chelsea Football Club owners Clearlake Capital agreed to buy out chairman Todd Boehly and director Mark Walter, bringing an end to a turbulent period among the clubs owners.

top_news.title: US Indictment Alleges Russian Global Assassination Network
top_news.summary: Last year, a former military officer in the Russian intelligence services named Yuri Khrameev offered $25,000 to a US citizen to track and kill someone in Lithuania’s capital who was “telling lies about Russia,” according to US prosecutors.

top_news.title: 'Direct Indexing' to Diversity Portfolios
top_news.summary: Manju Boraiah, Senior PM and Head of Systematic Fixed Income at Allspring Global Investment, reacts to Wednesday's Fed rate decision saying fundamentally, 'we needed the hike.' He also discusses how investors can break out from frozen positions, arguing that trillions of dollars of wealth is sitting in concentrated positions that are being held back by tax bills, and offers a possible solution to move toward diversification.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Bond Traders Signal Warsh Credibility Growing in Inflation Fight
top_news.summary: The bond market is signaling growing confidence that Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh will act on his vow to tame inflation, which has exceeded policymakers’ target for half a decade.

top_news.title: Brown Harris Stevens CEO: We Need More Housing in Market
top_news.summary: Bess Freedman, CEO of Brown Harris Stevens, discusses a growing divide between affluent buyers and everyone else in the housing market. In response to a comparison with luxury consumer spending, Freedman says high-end real estate can often keep moving even when broader economic pressures, including Federal Reserve policy and higher mortgage rates, weigh on typical buyers. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Bloomberg Surveillance: The Fed Decides 9/16/2026
top_news.summary: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates by a quarter percentage point and plans an additional hike later this year to contain inflation. Jon Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Tom Keene host a special edition of "Bloomberg Surveillance" covering the latest news from the Federal Reserve. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: AI Buildout Hits Inflation as Fed Hikes Rates
top_news.summary: Stephanie Aliaga, Global Market Strategist at JPM Asset Management, reacts to Fed Chair Warsh's remarks after raising interest rates. She argues that while oil prices are a long-term driver of inflation, the AI buildout is also having a significant impact. She argues slowing the AI frontier will help with adoption, and ultimately boost productivity. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Calpers CEO Bonus Jumps 43% After Pension Returns Beat Target
top_news.summary: California Public Employees’ Retirement System voted Wednesday to give its chief executive officer a $1.1 million bonus and a salary bump as state workers fight for higher pay.
